snippet.title: Bubble Bobble 2 - Amstrad CPC Hack Gameplay
snippet.description:
With the name like that, you would assume that this was an official sequel like on the NES, but in reality, it's actually a rom hack of Software Creations' CPC port, made by someone going by U.W. representing Saturn-Soft, a made up developer name, in 1988. The game is the same as the first except instead of Bub, you play as Bob this time. The levels are also harder, more complex and sometimes even telling you to call it quits.

Bubble Bobble (C) TAITO CORPORATION
Hack by Saturn-Soft / U.W.
